title: #403 Art Education
prompt: What is your opinion on the importance of arts education in schools?

promptSegments.text: What is your opinion on the importance of arts education in schools?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Art helps students develop their imagination.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Arts education boosts creativity by providing methods for students to use their imagination and express difficult feelings, thereby increasing self-confidence.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Arts education boosts creativity by providing methods for students to use their imagination and express difficult feelings, thereby increasing self-confidence.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: It enhances critical thinking skills because students must make choices regarding color and form, which teaches them structured problem-solving.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: It enhances critical thinking skills because students must make choices regarding color and form, which teaches them structured problem-solving.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Art education is not as important as people think because it takes up time from core academic subjects.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Art education is not as important as people think because it takes up time from core academic subjects.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Arts education does not help students learn better because time spent on art does not improve measurable skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Arts education does not help students learn better because time spent on art does not improve measurable skills.

modelPlan.focus: To argue the importance of arts education in schools by highlighting its role in fostering creativity, enhancing cognitive skills, and promoting holistic development.
keyArguments: Arts education cultivates creativity and imagination, essential for personal and professional growth.
Incorporating arts into the curriculum improves cognitive skills and academic performance.
